name: @idfkit/language-server
description: Language server for EnergyPlus model text. Translates the idfkit language service into the Language Server Protocol.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --format=esm --platform=node --target=node18 --external:@idfkit/* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __nodeCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __nodeCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --sourcemap
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.copyFileSync('../capabilities.json', 'dist/capabilities.json'); fs.copyFileSync('../LICENSE', 'LICENSE')"
scripts.postpack: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/capabilities.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('LICENSE', { force: true })"
